panel.selectRequest: Open a request, or bring a new one.

newRequest.dropDescription: Images are read by the assistant; other files go along with the request.

thread.analysing: The assistant is looking at it…
thread.filesFailed: These files did not reach the card:
thread.notAnalysed: Not analysed: hourly analysis limit reached

actions.connectFirst: Allow the assistant to reach Factory first: Settings › Assistant.
actions.noFactories: There is no Factory you can reach.
actions.question: Question

actions.title: Card title

notes.placeholder: A note for yourself… Markdown works.
notes.title: Notes
notes.emptyDescription: Keep what you want to remember — a reply to send, a call to make. Only you see them.
notes.select: Open a note, or start a new one.
notes.gone: This note is no longer here.
notes.saveFailed: Not saved — keep typing to retry

settings.title: Assistant
settings.description: Your own assistant in this organization. Factories and the organization's admins do not see it.
settings.modelDescription: One of the organization's models. Leave it on the default to follow the organization.
settings.noModels: The organization has no model connected yet.
settings.retentionDescription: Closed requests, their threads and files are erased after this many days.
settings.factoryAccessDescription: Lets the assistant ask a Factory and hand requests over as you, with your role.

accessResult.connected: The assistant can now reach Factory as you.
accessResult.denied: You did not allow the assistant.
accessResult.failed: Allowing the assistant failed. Try again.
accessResult.signed_out: Sign in again, then allow the assistant.

settings.clearDescription: Erases every request, note, file and the assistant's memory in this organization, and withdraws its access to Factory.
settings.clearConfirmDescription: Everything it kept in this organization is erased. This cannot be undone.
settings.runsOnDescription: The model the assistant's next turn actually uses, and why.
settings.runsNothing: Nothing: the organization has no model the assistant can run
settings.onlyFree: The only models that work in this organization now are free ones (OpenCode). Their provider may use what it is sent to improve its models: keep that in mind for clients' data.
settings.providersDescription: How each provider fared last for you: a turn or a model check that worked, or why it failed.
settings.checkDescription: A tiny call to the model the assistant runs on now, to see that it answers.
settings.reachableDescription: The Factories the assistant can reach as you.
settings.reasonFactoryDefault: A new Factory chat in your organization starts on this model when the Factory sets none.
settings.reasonOrgPreference: The organization's first model that works right now.

composer.askPlaceholder: Question for {{factory}} — leave empty to send the request as it is
composer.handOverPlaceholder: A note for the card in {{factory}} (optional)
composer.factoryHint: Goes out as you, with your role.

sources.tokenHelp: Paste your own personal API token: in ClickUp, avatar › Settings › Apps › API Token (starts with pk_). The assistant only reads the chats you turn on below and never writes to ClickUp. The token is stored encrypted and only you can use it.
sources.disconnectDescription: The token, your channel modes and read positions are erased. Requests already made from ClickUp stay until you close and clear them.
sources.rejected: ClickUp no longer accepts this token, so reading stopped. Paste a new token to connect again.
sources.syncFailed: The last read failed: {{error}}. It is retried automatically.
sources.modesHelp: For each chat, choose what becomes a request. Only new messages are read from when you turn a chat on. Off: not read. When addressed: DMs, mentions of you, replies in threads you are in. Everything: every new thread.
sources.noChannelsHint: ClickUp listed no channels or DMs for this token. Press «Read now» after joining one.
sources.orgHelp: The organization's ClickUp connection uses your own ClickUp account ({{workspaces}}), so the assistant can read your chats with it — no second token. Only you see this option.
sources.orgGone: The organization's ClickUp connection was removed or no longer uses your account, so reading stopped. Connect your own personal token.

detailsFailed.followers: Could not check whether it is in your sidebar (code {{code}})

sources.nothingFoundHint: No chat, person or location matches «{{query}}».

no_model.title: The organization has no model connected
no_model.fix: An admin connects one in Settings › Models; then retry.

rate_limit.title: {{model}}: limit reached or no credits
rate_limit.fix: Choose another model in Settings › Assistant, or top up this provider, then retry.

auth.title: {{model}}: the API key was refused
auth.fix: The key is invalid or has no access. An admin replaces it in Settings › Models, or choose another model in Settings › Assistant.

model_not_found.title: {{model}}: the provider has no such model
model_not_found.fix: Choose another model in Settings › Assistant.

overloaded.title: {{model}}: the provider is overloaded or down
overloaded.fix: Retry in a minute, or choose another model in Settings › Assistant.

unknown.title: {{model}}: the assistant could not answer
unknown.fix: Retry; if it fails again, choose another model in Settings › Assistant.

behavior.versionHint: Each reply's details name the version it ran on.
behavior.hint: The assistant's base instructions, as one Markdown document. Your version replaces the default; «Changes» shows what differs. Whatever it says, the assistant reports to you only and only proposes Factory actions.

skills.newDescription: A skill of your own: only your assistant has it.
skills.editDescription: Saving keeps your text for your assistant only: the original and every Factory's edits stay as they are.
skills.overriddenNote: You changed this skill for your assistant. «Restore original» drops your text.

preview.promptHint: Exactly what the next turn runs on: version {{version}}, model {{model}}. It is your base document, the skills index and a guard no edit removes.

rules.title: Chat rules
rules.for: What to do with new requests from {{channel}}
rules.noChannels: No chats turned on: turn some on in Sources.
rules.hint: «Analyse and ask» starts a side session in that Factory by itself (it costs), at most 10 a day; past that it becomes a proposal you confirm.

digest.frequencyDescription: A request summing up what is open in your inbox.
digest.hourDescription: The hour, in your time zone.
digest.saveDescription: The next digest is scheduled from it.

pending.label: Proposed action
pending.byRule: the chat's rule (today's limit is spent)
pending.question: Question
pending.title: Card

events.ruleAsk: The chat's rule asks the Factory
events.autoAskFailed: The chat's rule could not ask the Factory
events.answerTimeout: No answer from the Factory in 15 minutes: check later with «Check answer»
events.digestOnly: Not analysed: the chat goes into the digest
